title: Example 1:Forecasts from previous periods with minimum portions
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:42 AM
In the following example, we assume that the demand registers are balanced.

Example 1:Forecasts from previous periods with minimum portions

MR Result O  180 150  80             2? kW
||] —_—_

MR Reas. |  Y;  P,  Y>            P.
08  09-1  01-1  09-2                01-2
200                        kW/Year

PerDem. § |——VWT HA

40%
Wght Port. |------------------------------

On installation of the device, a period demand value of 200 kWh/year is entered for the register.
The minimum portion of weighting in percent is 30%.
The sum of the weighting units for one year is 1000.

With a weighting portion of 40%, period 09-2 to 08 is representative. This means that extrapolation is based on meter reading
results rather than on the period demand.

1. Determination of the highest meter reading from previous reading 09-2 over a representative interval (09-2 to 08):

180 kw
2. Determined demand = expected demand:

180 kW

The expected meter reading at time P is 180 kWh.
